content.value_statement: HTML email work is difficult because email clients render styles differently. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through React Email templates, previews, sending, and accessibility.
actual_capabilities: Create React Email templates with Html, Head, Body, Container, Tailwind, and pixelBasedPreset.
Generate plain text and HTML render guidance for transactional email workflows.
Plan Resend, Nodemailer, Mailgun, and SendGrid sending examples.
Apply email-safe styling rules for spacing, borders, images, and dark mode.
Use i18n examples for next-intl, react-intl, and react-i18next.
Embed and configure the React Email visual editor.
limitations: It does not access a Resend account by itself.
It cannot guarantee rendering in every email client without testing.
It uses placeholder domains and recipients in examples.
It expects users to provide verified sending domains and provider credentials.

use_cases.title: Create Transactional Templates
use_cases.description: Build welcome, password reset, notification, receipt, and order confirmation emails with reusable React components.

use_cases.title: Standardize Email Rendering
use_cases.description: Apply React Email structure, Tailwind pixel units, plain text rendering, and accessibility checks across a product team.

use_cases.title: Add an Email Editor
use_cases.description: Embed the React Email visual editor, configure themes, and export editor content to email-ready output.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Welcome Email
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the react-email skill to create a welcome email for a SaaS product. Include preview text, a clear heading, body copy, and one action button.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the react-email skill to review this email template for React Email structure, Tailwind email safety, image handling, accessibility, and plain text rendering.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Sending Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the react-email skill to plan a Resend sending flow for this template. Ask for the verified domain, sender, recipient rules, and required environment variables.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Localized Email System
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the react-email skill to design localized transactional emails with supported locales, translated subjects, RTL support, fallback messages, and rendering tests.

output_examples.input: Create a password reset email for a consumer app.
output_examples.output: A React Email plan with component structure, preview text, secure reset link handling, email-safe styling, and plain text rendering notes.

output_examples.input: Review our newsletter template before launch.
output_examples.output: A compatibility checklist covering Tailwind classes, table-safe layout, image formats, unsubscribe placement, dark mode risk, and accessibility issues.
An i18n approach with required locale props, translated subject guidance, currency formatting, RTL direction handling, and locale rendering tests.

best_practices: Ask for brand colors, production asset URLs, verified sender domains, and provider credentials before sending guidance.
Use React Email components and pixel-based Tailwind utilities instead of browser-only layout features.
Render and review both HTML and plain text versions before production sends.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode localhost, placeholder domains, or temporary recipients in production templates.
Do not use SVG, WEBP, flexbox, grid, or unsupported media query patterns for broad email compatibility.
Do not send real emails or upload templates without explicit user confirmation.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build React Email templates, render output, configure sending examples, and embed the React Email editor.

faq.question: Can it send emails by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples. Actual sending requires user credentials, provider setup, and explicit tool access.

faq.question: Which email providers are covered?
faq.answer: The references include Resend, Nodemailer, Mailgun, and SendGrid examples.

faq.question: Does it support localization?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes examples for next-intl, react-intl, react-i18next, translated subjects, fallback messages, and RTL layouts.

faq.question: Does it replace email client testing?
faq.answer: No. It improves template quality, but teams should still test rendering in their target email clients.

faq.question: Can it help with accessibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers preview text, heading order, alt text, link text, language attributes, and plain text output.
